notes.title: FORGOTTEN'S most anticipated update
notes.notes:
Forgotten's most anticipated update is out!

SUBTITLES

A lot of people have been asking for subtitles so they have been finally added to the game.

BUG FIXES
[olist]
Last item was hard to be picked up. This has been resolved.
Some framerate issues have been resolved.
[/olist]

DLC LAUNCH

The Soundtrack of Forgotten has officially launched and is available for purchase! If you want to support us you can buy a copy and have a closer listen to it.
The soundtrack includes
[olist]
Music
SFX
And some extra and unused stuff
[/olist]

Thank you for your patience, and enjoy.
-Out of Body Experience

notes.title: Camera Hotfix (1.0) + Roadmap
notes.notes:
This is a hotfix update that improves the camera control drastically. We'll also include a roadmap for the near future.

_____

Camera Control Update
We had a lot of criticism that complained about the camera control. And they were right, so we had to do something before the major updates as we said in the previous posts.

The camera will now rotate with the player every time you move. This improves ease of camera control and lets you focus more on the simple stuff

Camera rotation in action shown here
Camera Rotation


The camera was also set in a way to be able to rotate around the player and not the junky movement it had before when you moved your mouse

Shown here
Camera Position

ROADMAP
The roadmap as shown in the cover art of this post is quite small but very important for the game to feel like a game. We'll keep working on it and update you with any news we have.

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes: FORGOTTEN: THE GAME's official release date has been finally announced. The game is coming out on February 13th, 2022. The game is gonna be released with a DLC called "Forgotten: The Soundtrack" which will include the music, sound effects (obviously), and some extra stuff that didn't get a chance to be in the game. Thank you so much to those who supported us so much during this journey and we hope we deliver a nice experience. Now, you may ask, what comes next? Well, we haven't thought a lot about what's next, meaning that we're gonna continue learning until the next mind-blowing idea comes to mind. To follow our projects, you can join the discord linked on the steam page. Thanks a lot for everything.
